experiment_data.hypothesis: A1 (SDF auxiliary loss + LoRA, no runtime refinement) eval on safelibero_object — tests whether SDF auxiliary training signal alone improves CAR over LoRA baseline. If A1 CAR > baseline, SDF training signal is beneficial and A3 failure is specific to runtime refinement. Critical diagnostic for separating training-time vs inference-time SDF contributions.
experiment_data.notes: A1 CAR 90% vs LoRA baseline 82% (+8pp) — SDF auxiliary training signal has clear positive effect on collision avoidance. Biggest gain on task1 chocolate_pudding: 46%→80% (+34pp). Also beats full-FT baseline (83%). A3 runtime refinement hurts: 74.5% vs A1's 90%, confirming refinement module is the bottleneck, not the SDF training signal. TSR=0% (same as LoRA baseline). Displacement greatly reduced (0.0027m vs baseline 0.01m). Result JSON: /root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/eval_safelibero_object_all_levelII_best_lora_baseline_seed0.json
